claims.label: Maggie Wegner Auditioned for Daily Wire Solo Show Two Days After Ben Shapiro's Amfest Speech
claims.claim: Per an email from Maggie Wegner that the host reads, a Daily Wire producer contacted her about 2 days after Ben Shapiro's Amfest speech to audition her for a solo show presented as a comedy show making fun of the right and the left, with Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson brought up immediately.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the timeline of the Amfest speech and confirm the producer's identity (protected in this episode); obtain any additional documentation Maggie may have referenced.

claims.label: Audition Script and AI Video Content Targeted Candace Owens
claims.claim: Per an email from Maggie Wegner that the host reads, the audition script and AI video were entirely about making fun of Candace Owens, and the producer said, "So when Candace or Tucker says something crazy, we would want you to make fun of it."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and verify the full audition script and AI video; confirm the producer's statements directly via call recordings referenced by Maggie.

claims.label: Maggie Wegner Declined the Audition Role
claims.claim: Per a text message the host shows, Maggie Wegner declined the Daily Wire audition role, texting the producer that making fun of Candace did not feel true to her beliefs.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the text message thread against phone records and identify the producer's account.

claims.label: Per Statement the Host Reads, Ben Shapiro Resigned From Breitbart News on March 13, 2016
claims.claim: Per the statement the host reads, Ben Shapiro publicly resigned from Breitbart News as of 9:00 PM Pacific, citing the company's handling of Michelle Fields' allegations that Corey Lewandowski assaulted her; the host dates the resignation to March 13, 2016.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the resignation statement against contemporaneous Breitbart News coverage and internal communications.

claims.label: Steve Bannon Publicly Described Ben Shapiro's Pattern of Attempted Hostile Takeovers
claims.claim: Steve Bannon stated at Amfest that Ben Shapiro "tried to take over Breitbart," "tried to take over David Horowitz's [organization]," and predicted he "will make a move on Turning Point."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Amfest Bannon speech and verify the complete context; cross-reference Bannon's prior public statements about Shapiro.

claims.label: Article the Host Reads Says Austin Smith Was Scheduled to Be Sentenced Tuesday for Petition Signature Fraud
claims.claim: Per a news article the host reads, Austin Smith, age 30, former Arizona state representative and Turning Point Action leader, was scheduled to be sentenced Tuesday for using nominating petitions that contained forged signatures, including forging a dead woman's signature, in a 2024 primary election bid.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the court docket and judgment from the Arizona sentencing court; confirm Austin Smith's exact dates of employment at Turning Point Action.

claims.label: Austin Smith Plead Guilty in Mid-November to Attempted Fraudulent Schemes and Practices
claims.claim: Per a news article the host reads, Austin Smith plead guilty in mid-November to charges of attempted fraudulent schemes and practices and illegal signing of election petitions.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the plea agreement and charging documents from the Arizona court.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Kirk's 'Oracle' Figure All But Confirmed His Premonition of Dying Young
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk saw an older Jewish man from Chicago, matched with him, if memory serves, through a school for the gifted, who all but confirmed Charlie's visions that he would die young and told him his death would save humanity; she shows a text in which Charlie writes that the man says he is 'being shaped for a time to save humanity'.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original text message thread for verification; investigate the identity of the "oracle" figure and his connection to the gifted school.

claims.label: Email the Host Reads Describes Daily Wire Producer as in "Panic Mode" During Casting
claims.claim: Per an email the host reads, the Daily Wire producer who contacted Maggie Wegner was in "panic mode" about casting the show, having only come up with the show concept the day before contacting her.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the timeline of the show's conception against internal Daily Wire communications if obtainable.

claims.label: Per Shapiro's Own Statement the Host Reads, He Joined Breitbart News Two Weeks Before Andrew Breitbart's Death
claims.claim: Per Ben Shapiro's own resignation statement that the host reads, he signed on with Breitbart News two weeks before Andrew Breitbart's death, which the host elsewhere dates to March 1, 2012.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact date of Shapiro's hiring through Breitbart employment records or contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: Host invokes decentralized intelligence (near-DIA framing)
claims.claim: The host uses near-DIA wording ("decentralized intelligence") to describe crowd-sourced investigative capacity, without the full agency brand line in this beat.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...for this department and I can see this. All of us decentralizing intelligence and me just being willing to share what you guys are sharing with me is what is solving the mystery...

claims.label: Host elevates mommy sleuth crowd investigators
claims.claim: The host praises "mommy sleuth(s)" as amateur / parent investigators sending tips, framed as part of the crowd intelligence effort.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-link M-16 Mommy Sleuth meme when register present; verify named contributor if identified.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...this. Here's a text message chain. Um, here I'm a mommy sleuth and I have access to this. Oh, I work for this department and I can see this. All of us decentraliz...

claims.label: Host Says Kanye Was Right in 2022 About Blackballing of Opponents
claims.claim: The host says Kanye West in 2022 said he would go "deathcon 3" on Jewish people, and that he was right about the blackballing of anyone who opposes a specific agenda.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Kanye West tweet and its date to confirm the wording the host paraphrases.
claims.transcript_snippet: And he told us that when he woke up, he was a little bit sleepy tonight, but when he woke up, he had plans cuz he was going to go deathcon 3 on Jewish people.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Fought the Daily Wire for Two Years and Public Knows Little
claims.claim: The host says she has spent two years effectively fighting the Daily Wire after leaving her job, and that 90 to 99 percent of what she has gone through is unknown to the public.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's account with the court filings and public statements in the Daily Wire dispute.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's now been two years, two entire years of my life that I have been effectively fighting just to, you know, go on living against the Daily Wire after leaving a job.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Bowyer Hired Austin Smith and Is the Lynchpin
claims.claim: The host says Austin Smith, the Turning Point Action former employee just sentenced in Arizona, was also hired by Tyler Bowyer, whom she calls the lynchpin.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Turning Point Action employment records for Austin Smith and who approved his hiring.
claims.transcript_snippet: Of course, he too was hired by Tyler Bowyer because I, as I have been telling you guys from the very beginning, Tyler Bowyer is the lynch pin.

claims.label: Host Says Bowyer Runs TPUSA and Staffed Nearly Everyone Around Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Bowyer has been running Turning Point USA and staffed nearly everyone who surrounded Charlie Kirk, and that he should be investigated more thoroughly.
claims.investigative_direction: Map the hiring chain of Charlie Kirk's staff and security against Bowyer's role using TPUSA org charts and former staff accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: He is the person who has been running Turning Point USA. He staffed nearly everyone that was surrounding Charlie and I think he needs to be investigated more thoroughly.

claims.label: Host Says She Scooped the Daily Wire Show the Day Before
claims.claim: The host says that the previous day her show scooped a Daily Wire news show designed to mock her and Tucker Carlson, and that some Daily Wire fan accounts hoped it was fake.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the previous episode's report with any Daily Wire announcement of the show.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was yesterday, just yesterday, that we scooped the Daily Wire's cringe news show designed quite literally with the intention to mock me and Tucker Carlson.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Was Not a Friend of Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro was not a friend of Charlie Kirk and that Charlie Kirk's assassination has catalyzed a certain derangement in Shapiro.
claims.investigative_direction: Review public and private Shapiro-Kirk communications and joint appearances to test the host's characterisation.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie Kirk's assassination has catalyzed a certain derangement in Ben Shapiro. Ben was not a friend of Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Worked Behind the Scenes to Stop Charlie's and Her Rise
claims.claim: The host says that once Shapiro saw Charlie Kirk as a threat, after the Kanye West tweet, he worked behind the scenes to complicate and stop Charlie's rise and hers.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify messages, donor contacts or witnesses showing Shapiro's behind-the-scenes efforts, which the host has not specified here.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben got to work behind the scenes trying to complicate and stop Charlie's rise and my rise.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Pressures Christians Financially to Go After Other Christians
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro's strategy is to find Christians and pressure them, usually through financial means, to go after other Christians when he gets angry.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain further casting emails or payment offers like Maggie Wegner's to see whether a pattern exists.
claims.transcript_snippet: his strategy is to find Christians and to pressure them usually through financial means to go after other Christians when he gets angry in particular.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Demanded Megyn Kelly's Allegiance Against Her and Tucker
claims.claim: The host says that at the end of last year Shapiro stepped onto Megyn Kelly's tour stage and demanded her allegiance against the host and Tucker Carlson, and that Kelly did not submit.
claims.investigative_direction: Review video of Shapiro's appearance on Kelly's tour and Kelly's own account of what he asked of her.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben stepped onto Megyn Kelly stage while she was on tour and he demanded her allegiance against me and Tucker.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Directs Attacks on Megyn Kelly Through Stooges
claims.claim: The host says Megyn Kelly has been under attack by Shapiro's stooges since, and that Shapiro is directing the attacks from behind the scenes.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the accounts or outlets attacking Kelly and any evidence linking them to Shapiro; the host offers none here.
claims.transcript_snippet: she has been under attack by his stooges since. Okay, Ben is directing that from behind the scenes.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Paid for a Prime Amfest Slot Right After Erika Kirk
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro paid money for a prime speaking slot at Amfest, taking the stage just after Erika Kirk opened, and used it to attack the host, Tucker Carlson and Megyn Kelly.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Amfest speaker schedule and any sponsorship or payment records for Shapiro's appearance.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben quite literally paid money for a prime speaking spot speaking slot uh at Amfest hitting the stage just after Erika Kirk opening opened

claims.label: Host Reads Maggie's Account That She Tried to Rewrite the Script and Could Not
claims.claim: The host reads Maggie Wegner's email saying she tried to rewrite the audition script in a way true to her, could not, and was advised by someone whose name is blacked out to contact a second person, who told her not to send the audition tape.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against the original, unredacted email and the people Maggie says advised her.
claims.transcript_snippet: I even tried to rewrite it in a way that was true to me, but I couldn't do it. It just felt like high school bullies.

claims.label: Maggie Says She Was Told Not to Share the AI Video After the Host Said She Knew
claims.claim: The host reads Maggie Wegner's email saying she was told not to share the AI video the day after the host announced on air that she knew about the planned show, and that she told the producer she had not leaked it.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish who told Maggie not to share the video and when, using the call receipts she says she supplied.
claims.transcript_snippet: I was told not to share the AI video the day after you announced on your show that you knew about the show that they were planning to launch.

claims.label: Maggie Says She Attached Proof of the Call and the Producer's Text
claims.claim: The host reads Maggie Wegner's email saying she attached the AI video, the text she sent the producer, and proof of the call, plus photos from the studio showing the show filming.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the attachments and call logs and check dates and metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: Attached below is the AI video that they sent me and the text that I sent the producer and also proof of the call.

claims.label: Host Says Ben Wanted the AI Video Sent Around Following Amfest
claims.claim: The host says the AI video sample was sent to young women to see if they would audition and that Ben Shapiro wanted it sent around following Amfest.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who produced and distributed the AI sample and whether Shapiro directed it; the host gives no direct evidence of his role here.
claims.transcript_snippet: this is an AI video sample of the show that Ben wanted sent around following Amfest.

claims.label: AI Sample Is Hosted by a Character Named Gossy Gossworthy
claims.claim: The AI sample shown by the host includes a character who welcomes viewers to "The More You Know No" and introduces herself as host "Gossy Gossworthy".
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original video file to confirm the show title and character name as spoken.
claims.transcript_snippet: Hey noowers, welcome back to The More You Know No. I'm your host Gossy Gossworthy.

claims.label: Host Plays AI Sample Parodying the Bee Code Theory and Kyle Robinson
claims.claim: In an AI sample video the host plays, which she says was sent to young women to audition for a show, the lines include coded talk of bees and end by asking how Kyle Robinson could be the bee that stung, because bees die when they sting and he is alive.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the AI sample's lines with the bee-code texts the host previously aired to see what is being parodied.
claims.transcript_snippet: Bees die when they sting. Kyle Robinson is alive. So, how could he be the bee that did the stinging?

claims.label: Host Says Maggie Did Not Get the Job After Refusing to Mock Her
claims.claim: The host says Maggie Wegner did not get the job because she went back to the producer and said it did not feel true to what she believed to make fun of Candace.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm with Maggie Wegner that she was not offered the role and obtain the producer's reply.
claims.transcript_snippet: she didn't get the job because she went back to them and she wrote and said, 'I feel uncomfortable doing this.

claims.label: Host Says the Casting Required Willingness to Attack Her
claims.claim: The host says the Daily Wire's message to would-be hosts amounts to a star-making show offer on the condition that they attack Candace Owens, and that this is what they were casting for.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek additional casting emails or scripts from other candidates to test whether the condition was stated.
claims.transcript_snippet: We can make you a star, but you have to be willing to attack Candace Owens. That's what we are casting for.

claims.label: Host Says Boreing Cited Her Stance That Genocide Is Always Wrong as a Reason She Was Fired
claims.claim: The host says Jeremy Boreing, in the company town hall, named her public position that genocide is always wrong as a reason she was fired from the Daily Wire.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full town hall video and transcript and compare Boreing's stated reasons with the host's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: the clearly immoral and impractical stance that I publicly expressed that genocide is always wrong was revealed by Jeremy Boreing in that town hall as a reason why I was fired.

claims.label: Host Says Boreing Also Cited Her View That Pornography Harms Men
claims.claim: The host says then-CEO Jeremy Boreing gave her position that pornography is harming men as another reason for her firing at the companywide town hall.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the town hall transcript and check what Boreing said about pornography.
claims.transcript_snippet: pornography is harming men. That was another reason that was expressed by then CEO Jeremy in the companywide town

claims.label: Host Says Her Michael Jackson Hollywood-Gang Remark Was Another Firing Reason
claims.claim: The host says another reason given for her firing was that, while speaking about Michael Jackson in a Daily Wire episode, she insinuated it is plausible that Hollywood is being run by a gang.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Daily Wire episode and obtain the town hall record of whether it was cited.
claims.transcript_snippet: I insinuated in an episode that I had done while I was at the Daily Wire when I was speaking about Michael Jackson that it's plausible that Hollywood is being run by a gang.

claims.label: Host Says Hollywood Was Started by Gangs Including Jewish Mafiosos
claims.claim: The host says Hollywood was in fact started by gangs, including Jewish mafiosos and bootleggers, so it is not beyond possibility that it is still run by a gang.
claims.investigative_direction: Check historians' accounts of organised crime involvement in early Hollywood against this sweeping characterisation.
claims.transcript_snippet: Actually, factually speaking, Hollywood was started by gangs. Yes, there were Jewish mafiosos, bootleggers.

claims.label: Host Says the Baldoni Lawsuit Showed a Hostile Takeover of His Movie Rights
claims.claim: The host says that after reading Justin Baldoni's lawsuit she concluded that Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively were sent to get the rights to his movie, which she calls a hostile takeover.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the Baldoni and Lively court filings and rulings to test the host's takeover reading.
claims.transcript_snippet: Even Justin Baldoni actually when I read the lawsuit and I realized they were trying to stage a hostile takeover of the rights to his movie.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Wanted Out of the Gang and Was Killed
claims.claim: The host says that if there is an entertainment gang that she and Charlie Kirk unwittingly joined, she has been getting jumped out for two years, and that Charlie, who wanted out, was killed.
claims.investigative_direction: This is the host's inference; identify any statement by Charlie Kirk that he wanted to leave a group or arrangement.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's dead now. What he wanted out, he was killed.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro May Know More Than the Public About Charlie's Death
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro's behaviour since the assassination leads her to believe he may know more than the public knows about Charlie Kirk's death, and that she feels this in her soul.
claims.investigative_direction: The host offers no specific evidence here; seek any communications or meetings of Shapiro on or after September 10, 2025 (see also the lunch-meeting topic).
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben Shapiro's behavior since Charlie Kirk's assassination leads me to believe that he may know more than the public knows about Charlie Kirk's death.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Acts as if Charlie's Company Was Promised to Him
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro is behaving as though Charlie's company was promised to him 3,000 years ago and that he assumed he would somehow benefit from Charlie's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for concrete Shapiro actions toward TPUSA after September 10, 2025 (offers, donor outreach, statements) that support the host's reading.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's behaving as though Charlie's company was promised to him 3,000 years ago. Okay? Like he assumed that he would somehow benefit off of his death.

claims.label: Bannon Says in the Clip That He Ran Shapiro Out of Breitbart
claims.claim: In the Amfest clip, Steve Bannon says Ben Shapiro tried to take over Breitbart and that he, Bannon, ran him out of there.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Bannon's statement with Shapiro's account that he resigned, and with contemporaneous Breitbart reporting.
claims.transcript_snippet: He tried to take over Breitbart and I ran him out of there.

claims.label: Bannon Says Shapiro Has Always Been Envious of Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: In the Amfest clip, Steve Bannon says Shapiro will make a move on Turning Point because he has always been envious of Charlie Kirk, and the host calls it fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Amfest Bannon speech and any corroborating statements by those who knew Kirk and Shapiro.
claims.transcript_snippet: he will make a move on Turning Point because he's always been envious of Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro's Lawsuit Aimed to Bankrupt Her Company Before It Started
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro tried to take over many companies hostilely, including hers before it got started, and that the lawsuit after she was fired was meant to bankrupt them before they could start.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the pleadings in the Daily Wire litigation against the host and their dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: The lawsuit just going to bankrupt us before we could even get started.

claims.label: Host Says Andrew Breitbart Died March 1, 2012 Aged 43 of an Apparent Heart Attack
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Breitbart dropped dead on March 1, 2012 of an apparent heart attack at age 43, and calls it another mysterious political death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Los Angeles County coroner's report for Breitbart's death.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was March 1st of 2012 when Andrew Breitbart dropped dead from an apparent heart attack.

claims.label: Host Says Breitbart Was Stepping on Toes and Claimed Information Before He Died
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Breitbart was stepping on some toes and saying he had some information shortly before he died.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify what information Breitbart said he had, using his public statements from early 2012.
